items.title: United Airlines Holdings (UAL) Received Its First A321XLR With New Long Range Engines
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings (NasdaqGS:UAL) received its first Airbus A321XLR equipped with Pratt & Whitney GTF Advantage engines. The new GTF Advantage powerplants are designed to provide higher thrust, improved durability, and more efficient fuel burn on long-range routes. This A321XLR delivery marks an early step in United Airlines' broader fleet modernization and long-haul narrowbody deployment plans. items.title: Pratt & Whitney Delivers First GTF Advantage-Powered Aircraft to United Airlines
items.summary: Pratt & Whitney, a division of RTX (NYSE:RTX), has delivered the first aircraft powered by its GTF Advantage engine to United Airlines (NASDAQ:UAL), introducing the new engine variant into commercial service. The aircraft is an Airbus A321XLR and represents the first delivery to an airline using the GTF Advantage configuration, according to Pratt & Whitney.
